newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan vegoil rates seen rising on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan vegoil rates seen rising on strong demand.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil prices are likely to rise next week on higher demand ahead of the Moslem festival of Eid al-Adha, dealers said on Friday.
"Local prices have suddenly boosted up ahead of Eid on April 18," one dealer said. The local market would continue to be bullish as demand would rise because of the festival, he added.

Another dealer said the rise in local prices would be temporary as 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes of local edible oils from rapeseed, sunflower and canola crops was expected to hit the market each month during the April-July period.
"Prices will come down after the Eid season," the dealer said.
